akka.event: Akka core first Scala 3 artifacts (2.6.17, Apache-2.0)
Last Apache releases of all modules (core 2.6.20, HTTP 10.2.10; others 08-30 to 09-06)
FAQ at announcement: existing versions get no additional features, enhancements, security updates or bug fixes
FAQ adds Play questions: Play users not directly using Akka exempt via Additional Use Grant; direct Akka users need production licence
FAQ revised: critical security updates and critical bugs patched in 2.6.x under Apache 2 until September 2023
First BSL artifact on Maven Central: 2.7.0-M1 (BUSL-1.1)
First stable BSL releases (core 2.7.0, HTTP 10.4.0; other modules 10-20/21); GitHub notes list 'Change license'
Scala 3 builds of all non-core modules appear only under BSL (HTTP, gRPC, Management, Kafka, Alpakka, Cassandra, Projection); none for persistence-jdbc
Last Apache patch 2.6.21: critical TLS fix backport only
End of life of Akka 2.6 and Akka HTTP 10.2
Akka 2.9.0 (GitHub 10-23); 23.10 release notes (10-31): published to Lightbend's own repository from this release; 2.9.0 GA absent from Maven Central
Licence keys required for production use of new versions 2.9.6, 2.8.7, 2.7.1; free for pre-production, OSS, startups, academia, personal
